ocr_samples: まったく!いったい何だって辞めろなんて..
寺のお偉いさんにバンドを辞めるように言われた...と
騒音で苦情が出てるらしくて..他人に迷惑をかけるのはダメだって..
来たけど言い出しづらくて
translations: Really! What in the world is it that tells me to quit…
The high-ranking person in the temple told me to quit the band…
It seems like there are complaints due to the noise pollution. It’s not allowed to cause trouble to others…
I came, but it was difficult to say anything at first…
